text:
olivia: Heads-up: Hosted API -- async-run endpoints are available as a developer preview for flagged orgs. This is for long-running tool integrations and background jobs (non-interactive). Docs: https://internal.redwood.com/docs/async-run-preview :mega:

raj: Nice! How does this fit with streaming/tool-calls?

olivia: Streaming and tool-call streaming are unchanged. Async-run is complementary: POST /v1/async/runs to enqueue, then poll GET /v1/async/runs/:id or provide callback_url for webhooks. Use when execution may take 10s->minutes.

nina: Preview keys are distributed via Console -> Settings -> Feature Previews. Ping me if you need access.

raj: Example curl?

olivia:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/async/runs \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_PREVIEW_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-compact-1","input":"batch extract","callback_url":"https://hooks.example.com/cb"}'
```

deploy-bot: Canary deploy: async-run-preview v0.1 rolling to us-west-2 now. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/deploys/async-preview :gear:

tim: Are runs region-scoped? If I create in eu-west-1 will compute stay there?

olivia: Yes, routing respects the optional region param and org settings. Preview supports us-west-2 and eu-west-1.

nina: Limits for preview: 5 concurrent runs/org, 2k run creations/day per preview key. Callback retry uses exponential backoff (5 retries).

raj: Any migration guidance for existing tool-call users?

olivia: No forced migration. Keep streaming for interactive flows. Async-run is for batch/long tasks. We'll publish a migration guide with patterns and cost comparisons shortly.

tim: Observability: will async runs show up in Console traces?

nina: Yes 12 Observability -> Async Runs shows run lifecycle, token counts, and callback status.

raj: Found a small bug: webhook payload missing run.metadata when callback_url provided. Filing INC-4923.

olivia: Thanks Raj 12 we'll triage. Please attach repro.

deploy-bot: Canary health: 8min, 0 critical errors, avg exec 3.8s, QPS 0.4.

olivia: Timeline: aiming for GA in ~6 weeks pending feedback and a small EA. Patch notes and migration guide will be posted in docs repo by EOD tomorrow. Join the demo tomorrow 11am PT (calendar invite sent). Feedback: #dev-experiments or DM me. :thumbsup:
